problem_text:
A logistics coordinator is tasked with allocating a set of shipments into identical cargo vessels. The shipments are as follows:

* Shipment Alpha: mass 30 tonnes
* Shipment Beta: mass 55 tonnes
* Shipment Gamma: mass 46 tonnes
* Shipment Delta: mass 45 tonnes
* Shipment Epsilon: mass 31 tonnes
* Shipment Zeta: mass 32 tonnes
* Shipment Eta: mass 69 tonnes
* Shipment Theta: mass 41 tonnes
* Shipment Iota: mass 58 tonnes
* Shipment Kappa: mass 68 tonnes
* Shipment Lambda: mass 39 tonnes
* Shipment Mu: mass 44 tonnes
* Shipment Nu: mass 69 tonnes
* Shipment Xi: mass 51 tonnes
* Shipment Omicron: mass 49 tonnes
* Shipment Pi: mass 55 tonnes
* Shipment Rho: mass 62 tonnes
* Shipment Sigma: mass 34 tonnes
* Shipment Tau: mass 62 tonnes
* Shipment Upsilon: mass 60 tonnes
* Shipment Phi: mass 44 tonnes
* Shipment Chi: mass 47 tonnes
* Shipment Psi: mass 46 tonnes
* Shipment Omega: mass 32 tonnes
* Shipment Asteria: mass 53 tonnes
* Shipment Boreas: mass 66 tonnes
* Shipment Caelus: mass 49 tonnes
* Shipment Draco: mass 66 tonnes
* Shipment Eurus: mass 46 tonnes
* Shipment Favonius: mass 44 tonnes
* Shipment Gaia: mass 49 tonnes
* Shipment Helios: mass 51 tonnes
* Shipment Iris: mass 63 tonnes
* Shipment Janus: mass 48 tonnes
* Shipment Krios: mass 47 tonnes
* Shipment Leto: mass 54 tonnes
* Shipment Metis: mass 61 tonnes
* Shipment Nyx: mass 37 tonnes

Each vessel has a maximum cargo capacity of 100 tonnes. The coordinator must assign every shipment to exactly one vessel, ensuring the combined mass in any vessel does not surpass its limit. The objective is to utilize the smallest possible number of vessels to accommodate all shipments.
